birthline_zh: 1969 年生於宜蘭｜油畫藝術家
tagline_zh: 創作源於生活，探索光影與存在的痕跡。
tagline_en: His works explore the traces of light, shadow, and existence.
home_intro: 山水有四時，花木有盛衰，在光影與色彩的流轉之間描繪自然景物不同時節的姿態與氣息。
home_intro_en: Landscapes shift with the seasons, while flowers bloom and fade. Through changing light and color, nature reveals its many moods and forms.
